scientific_role: Nonlinear tree-ensemble baseline for cross-cycle predictive and explanation stability analysis.

candidate_design_rationale.max_depth: Tests moderate depth, deeper trees, and unrestricted depth while controlling the search space before validation.
candidate_design_rationale.min_samples_leaf: Tests fine-grained leaves versus regularized leaves to reduce possible overfitting.
candidate_design_rationale.class_weight: Compares the unweighted model against balanced_subsample because M/X flare positives are rare in Cycle24 TRAIN.
candidate_design_rationale.n_estimators: Fixed at 500 to provide a sufficiently large ensemble while avoiding an unnecessary validation-tuned axis.
candidate_design_rationale.max_features: sqrt is fixed as a standard RF decorrelation mechanism and is not tuned using validation data.

selection_protocol.threshold_strategy: For each frozen RF candidate, choose the decision threshold that maximizes TSS on Cycle24 validation only.
selection_protocol.winner_rule: Select the RF candidate with highest Cycle24 validation TSS after its candidate-specific threshold selection.

immutability_rule: After this protocol is frozen, RF candidate hyperparameters, candidate count, feature set, training split, and preprocessing may not be changed in response to validation, holdout, or Cycle25 results.
